steps.title: Transform and grow Tn5 expression bacteria
steps.instruction: Transform the pTXB1‑Tn5 expression vector into C3013 cells, plate on LB agar containing 100 µg/mL ampicillin and incubate 16 h at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Pick colonies and inoculate 10 mL LB broth with 100 µg/mL ampicillin; grow 16 h at 37 °C, 200 rpm.
Add the 10 mL starter culture to 1 L LB broth pre‑supplemented with 100 µg/mL ampicillin in a fresh flask.
Incubate at 37 °C, 200 rpm until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.6 (≈3–4 h).

steps.title: Induce Tn5 expression and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Induce Tn5 expression, chill, and collect the bacterial pellet.

substeps.instruction: Cool the culture on ice for 30 min once OD₆₀₀ = 0.6.
Add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.25 mM (prepare fresh) and incubate 16 h at 18 °C, 200 rpm.
Centrifuge at 4000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and flash‑freeze the pellet at –80 °C for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Lyse cells and clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend frozen pellet, lyse, and clarify the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 40 mL chilled HEGX buffer containing 1× Roche Complete EDTA‑free protease inhibitor tablet; optionally add 10 µL Benzonase nuclease.
Lyse cells using a Bioruptor Plus sonicator at 50 % duty cycle on ice (or French press/microfluidizer).
Centrifuge the sonicated lysate at 30 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Remove nucleic acids with PEI precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate contaminating E. coli DNA with PEI and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.05 mL of 10 % PEI (pH 7) dropwise to the stirring lysate.
Centrifuge 10 min at 9000 × g at 4 °C and retain the clarified supernatant.

steps.title: Bind Tn5 to chitin column and wash
steps.instruction: Capture the His‑tagged Tn5 on a chitin column and perform extensive washes.

substeps.instruction: Pack a disposable column with 2 mL chitin slurry resin (Econo‑Pac).
Wash column with 30 mL HEGX buffer.
Slowly load the soluble fraction onto the resin and rotate at 4 °C for ≥8 h.
Wash column thoroughly with 40 mL HEGX buffer.

steps.title: Elute, dialyze, and concentrate Tn5 protein
steps.instruction: Elute Tn5, dialyze, and adjust concentration as needed.

substeps.instruction: Elute with 10 mL elution buffer (HEGX + 100 mM DTT) on a rotator at 4 °C for 48 h.
Collect eluate and dialyze twice against 500 mL Tn5 Dialysis Buffer.
Measure A₂₈₀; 1.0 AU = 0.616 mg/mL (11.56 µM). If required, concentrate using Amicon Ultra‑4 30 kDa filters to an A₂₈₀ of 2.5.

steps.title: Prepare glycerol stock and assess activity
steps.instruction: Store Tn5 and verify its transposition efficiency.

substeps.instruction: Add sterile 100 % glycerol 1:1 (v/v) to the purified protein to obtain a final 50 % glycerol stock; store at –20 °C or –80 °C.
Load purified Tn5 with adapters (as described later).
Perform a tagmentation test on 50 ng purified genomic DNA (e.g., HeLa DNA).
Determine the PCR cycle number that reaches 1/3 of maximum fluorescence and compare to a commercial TDE1 Nextera reaction.
Dilute Tn5 in Dilution Buffer to match the efficiency of the commercial transposome.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse and dissect lung tumors
steps.instruction: Harvest lung adenocarcinoma tissue from mice.

substeps.instruction: Euthanize mouse in an isoflurane chamber.
Dissect whole tumor‑laden lung or individual tumors and place each in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube containing 100 µL Lung Digestion Buffer (per manufacturer’s kit).
Finely mince tissue with scissors and add an additional 0.5 mL Lung Digestion Buffer.

steps.title: Digest tumor tissue with lung digestion buffer

substeps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 37 °C with rotation for 30 min.

steps.title: Filter and wash digested cells
steps.instruction: Separate single cells from debris and collect them.

substeps.instruction: Pass the digested suspension over a 100 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube using a pipette tip.
Add 5 mL S‑MEM medium over the filter to wash remaining material into the tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells with ACK buffer

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Incubate on the bench at 25 °C for 2 min.

steps.title: Quench lysis and wash cells
steps.instruction: Stop the ACK reaction and prepare cells for staining.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL DMEM to quench the lysis.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 µL FACS Buffer.

steps.title: Stain cells for FACS sorting
steps.instruction: Label cells with antibodies and viability dye.

substeps.instruction: Add APC‑conjugated CD45 (BD, catalog 559864), CD11b (eBioscience, 15‑0112‑82), CD31 (BioLegend, 102510), and Ter119 (BD, 557909) each at 1:1000 dilution.
Add DAPI (stock 5 mg/mL) at 1:10 000 dilution.
Optional: treat with a dead‑cell removal kit (Miltenyi, cat 103‑090‑101) as recommended.

steps.title: Sort viable tumor cells for fixation
steps.instruction: Isolate the desired cell population by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Using a FACS Aria, gate for APC‑negative (immune‑depleted), tdTomato‑positive, and DAPI‑negative cells.
Collect the sorted cells into FACS Buffer and proceed to fixation and transposition (details not included in this excerpt).
